items.rationale: An insured event under 2.6 occurred, and the battery health waiver means 2.6.8 does not apply. The supplier report shows repair is uneconomic, so 7.1.10 pays the acquisition cost of an equivalent unit; calibrated to the Case 5 laptop level.
7.1.9 bars improvement over the pre-loss standard; the upgrade difference is borne by the policyholder.
Under 2.6.4 the tablet is a second unit damaged in the same event and is assessed on its own. A screen crack is covered under 2.6.3(a); the repair is priced at the upper customary range.
Examination costs are covered under 5.2.3 for each affected unit, even where repair proves uneconomic, capped at EUR 250 per event. Two devices at roughly the Case 2 level per device gives about 140.
Under 4.2.6 and 7.1.5 an accessory or case is indemnified only if it was itself damaged; this bag was not.
Warranties and service contracts are excluded by 3.5(f), 4.3(f) and 7.1.8(e).

items.description: Data recovery from damaged laptop drive
items.rationale: 3.5(d) excludes data recovery unless it is additionally agreed under 4.3(c), and the description shows no such agreement.
Administrative charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b), and this line is also ancillary to the excluded data recovery.
